responses.text: I hope they don't close the quarry. I need the money.
With Chomps in jail, who's going to run things at the quarry? He was our most experienced guy!
Maybe I was just seeing things, but I could've sworn I saw some people up on the ridge by the quarry.
I can't believe Chomps got arrested! They said he was involving in smuggling, if you can believe it.
The Deathclaws have been keeping their distance. For now.
When do you think the NCR will send their troops to help us?
Jas screwed up the coffee again. Wouldn't drink it if I were you.
{player fixed generator} Sure is nice to have the lights on again.
{Deathclaw Mother and Alpha dead} With the Deathclaw pack leaders dead, I hope we can get back to work soon.
{player healed Snuffles} Snuffles' leg seems to have gotten better.
Man, I wish I'd stayed back in California some days.
Generator's still not working. Big surprise.
Poor Snuffles. Wish somebody could do something about his leg.
